question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

There are six teachers in a school, viz. P, Q, R, S, T and U. Since there is no games teacher in the school, each of the teachers is allocated one day for taking games class among six days of the week. There is no class on Sunday. R takes the class on the very next day to that of Q. P takes the class on Friday and S takes the class on Wednesday. T takes the class next day after S.

On which day does U take the class?
